summary: Test-writing run for issue #39. Committed: (1) the solver parity corpus mirrored byte-for-byte from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) with an independent Python replay that verifies it exactly (12/12 scenarios, 5 ties, 2 null selections); (2) SolverParityCorpusTests.swift replaying every scenario through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer with earliest-wins selection, asserting exact scores/selections/ties/exclusions; (3) GeneratedOpenAPIClientTests.swift (red until implementation: Package.swift OpenAPI stack, committed OpenAPI document at the plugin layout, /api/v1 endpoint coverage); (4) PaletteAPIClientMigrationTests.swift pinning PaletteAPIClient observable behavior the migration must preserve; (5) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md (corpus location/refresh, parity findings, migration notes, /api/v1 shape findings). No Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container (bin/lint skips: 'Swift toolchain not available'), so swift test could not be executed here; the committed tests target the macOS host per README. Implementation (Package.swift wiring, OpenAPI document, client migration) is intentionally out of scope for this tests-only phase.
